column1: # allowed_x50eyeguard.tsv: the complete list of gmpf calls the X50 eye-protection fail-safe (apps/X50EyeGuard,
# org.lumen.x50.eyeguard) may send on the X50 (G0111, X50 Ultra, mt9681, stock v1.2.64). Every row is a Call of
# apps/X50EyeGuard/src/org/lumen/x50/eyeguard/Gmpf.java and every Call a row (rule 6 of tools/devices/check_aidl_hal.py,
# which the app's test/run.sh runs on its sources and on its dex, with research/aidl_codes.tsv and
# devices/goat_elegant/research/banned.tsv).
# 2026-11-07 boot handshake (B1): every vendor
# human-detection path waits for SystemManager 32 setBootAnimState(2), so the app sends the stock handshake (32 with 1
# and 2, 36 with 1, PowerManager 2 with 0 and 1, each value a constant of one Gmpf method). These are per-boot runtime
# signals, the same the stock system sends on every boot.
# 2026-11-08 owner rule: the app never changes the user's eye-protection settings. The vendor stores them outside
# /data, in its Env store (xgimicri partition), shared by the stock system, a DSU trial and Lumen
# (libxgimi disassembly): 61 setHumanDetectOnOff and 101 setHumanDetectOnOffEx write
# HumanDetect_OnOff (the stock switch "smart eye protection"), 126 setHumanDetectMode writes hd_cutout_mask_mod (the
# follow / safe mode). 66 setHumanDetectScreenOnOff is not stored but drives the vendor's own eye-protection cover (light
# flag 0x400, events 503 / 603), so it is gone too, with its getter 67. The blank is the app's own black full-screen
# window (Cover). Only getters of the settings remain: 127 mode, 62 switch. EyeGuardTest refuses rows and Calls for 61,
# service

column1: DisplayManager
column5: read only: the eye-protection mode (0 eye follow, 1 full screen), the user's choice; with the drawer down, 1 needs nothing and anything else covers the picture (Enforce.mode); stock wrapper GmDisplayManager.getHumanDetectMode (X50 SystemUI EyeProtect30Core, newsettings MoreViewModel); X50_HARDWARE_SAFETY.md section 4 "127 allow"

column1: DisplayManager
column5: read only: the user's eye-protection switch (stock settings toggle "smart eye protection" = 61 + persist.sys.humandetect.enable); libxgimi HumDet_MixedRuntime::getHumanDetectOnOff is Database::getEnv("HumanDetect_OnOff"); off = not armed, the picture stays covered and the notice asks the user to turn it on (StockSwitch, Armed.withSwitch)

column1: SystemManager
column5: values 1 and 2 only (Gmpf.bootAnimRunning / bootAnimStopped): stock libbootanimation BootAnimation constructor (1) and end of threadLoop (2); HumDet, AK, AF wait for 2

column1: SystemManager
column5: read back after the handshake and every 60 s, an unreadable read again 3 s later (5 reads in a row at most): 2 = what the vendor detector waits for (Armed.java)

column1: SystemManager
column5: value 1 only (Gmpf.systemUiReady): stock SystemUI FocusUIV2.start -> SystemUtils.systemUIServicesCompleted

column1: PowerManager
column5: values 0 and 1 only (Gmpf.bootCompletedEarly / bootCompletedLate): stock XRMService.initXRMServices (0) and BootControlService.bootCompletedCheck after unlock and bootanim stop (1)
